description: LOW MILEAGE, 4X4, COLD WEATHER PACKAGE, NONSMOKER, READY FOR ALL FOUR SEASONS! The 2020 Jeep Compass Latitude 4x4 delivers the manageable dimensions and everyday efficiency of a compact crossover with a dose of the genuine all-weather capability buyers expect from the Jeep name. Finished in crisp White Clearcoat and showing just 49,134 miles, this Compass becomes especially appealing with its COLD WEATHER GROUP, POPULAR EQUIPMENT GROUP, and 9-speed automatic transmission. That combination makes a real difference in daily ownership. Heated front seats, a HEATED STEERING WHEEL, remote start, windshield wiper de-icer, upgraded power driver's seat, and Jeep's 4x4 system give this Compass the equipment to make cold mornings and difficult weather considerably more manageable. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Compass occupies a useful middle ground in Jeep's lineup. It's substantially easier to maneuver and park than a larger SUV, yet it retains the upright seating position, useful cargo flexibility, and available four-wheel-drive capability crossover shoppers want. For buyers living with four distinct seasons, the 4x4 version is particularly attractive. Jeep's Active Drive system can automatically manage power between the front and rear axles as traction needs change, while selectable Selec-Terrain settings allow the driver to tailor the vehicle's behavior for different conditions. This particular Compass goes a step beyond the typical Latitude. Nearly $2,000 in Cold Weather and Popular Equipment packages add many of the comfort and convenience features owners interact with most often, while the factory 9-speed automatic completes a well-rounded configuration. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The Compass has been recognized for offering authentic Jeep styling and useful off-pavement capability in a compact, approachable package. Contemporary reviewers particularly noted the Compass's capable available four-wheel-drive systems, user-friendly infotainment, and distinctive styling. The 2020 Compass also received a 4-Star Overall Vehicle Score from NHTSA. For shoppers who want a compact crossover with more rugged character than the typical car-based alternative, the Compass offers a combination that relatively few competitors attempt to duplicate. Warranty The odometer is showing only 49,134 miles. With an original registration date of August 31, 2020, that's only about 8,200 miles per year--LOW annualized mileage for a vehicle of this age. The supplied CARFAX information also shows 16 service records and REGULAR OIL CHANGES, both worthwhile ownership-history signals when evaluating a pre-owned vehicle. The original Jeep factory warranty coverage has expired based on time. Installed Options This Compass was equipped with approximately $3,490 in listed factory options and packages beyond its underlying configuration, including two especially worthwhile equipment groups. Cold Weather Group -- $995 Heated Front Seats Helps take the edge off cold-weather driving before the cabin fully warms. Heated Steering Wheel One of those winter features that's difficult to give up once you've had it. Remote-Start System Allows the vehicle to begin warming or cooling before you get inside. Windshield Wiper De-Icer Helps prevent ice accumulation around the windshield-wiper area in freezing conditions. Popular Equipment Group -- $995 8-Way Power Driver's Seat Provides convenient adjustment for a more personalized driving position. 4-Way Power Lumbar Adjustment Adds useful lower-back support adjustment for longer drives. 6-Way Manual Passenger Seat Gives the front passenger useful seating-position flexibility. 7.0-Inch Color Driver Information Display Places vehicle, trip, and driving information directly in the instrument cluster. Auto-Dimming Rearview Mirror Automatically helps reduce distracting glare from headlights behind the vehicle. 115-Volt Auxiliary Power Outlet Adds useful household-style power capability for compatible devices. 9-Speed 948TE Automatic Transmission -- $1,500 The optional 9-speed automatic replaces the manual transmission and includes AutoStick manual-shift capability and a leather-wrapped shift knob. Rear-seat center-console air vents are also included with this configuration, helping distribute climate-controlled air throughout the cabin. Mechanical Features Under the hood is Jeep's 2.4-liter Tigershark MultiAir 2 four-cylinder engine, rated at 180 horsepower and 175 lb-ft of torque. Paired here with the optional 9-speed automatic, it provides straightforward everyday performance while retaining the efficiency and manageable operating characteristics expected from a compact crossover. The 4x4 system is the more important distinction. Jeep Active Drive can automatically engage four-wheel-drive capability as conditions require, while a 4WD LOCK function allows the driver to command a more consistent front/rear torque split when extra traction is needed. Selec-Terrain further expands that versatility with AUTO, SNOW, SAND, and MUD settings. Instead of simply carrying a 4x4 badge, the Compass gives its driver tools specifically designed for changing surfaces and weather. Exterior Features White Clearcoat works especially well with the Compass's unmistakably Jeep design. The seven-slot grille, squared wheel openings, upright proportions, and sculpted body sides give it a recognizable family resemblance without making this compact SUV unnecessarily bulky. The Latitude trim dresses up that rugged foundation with alloy wheels and additional exterior detailing, creating a crossover that looks equally appropriate commuting during the week or heading out of town for the weekend. The Cold Weather Group's windshield wiper de-icer is an exterior feature worth emphasizing in colder climates. Combined with remote start and 4x4 capability, it contributes to a vehicle configuration clearly equipped with winter usability in mind. Interior Features The Compass's upright design pays dividends inside, providing a comfortable driving position and useful passenger space within relatively compact exterior dimensions. The Latitude trim adds a more finished cabin environment, while this vehicle's Popular Equipment Group meaningfully improves driver comfort. The 8-way power driver's seat and 4-way power lumbar adjustment make it easier to dial in a comfortable seating position, and heated front seats plus the heated steering wheel are especially welcome during winter. Rear center-console air vents help improve comfort for passengers in the second row. The split-folding rear seating and practical cargo area make the Compass useful for luggage, shopping, recreational gear, or the miscellaneous hauling that becomes part of everyday SUV ownership. The reversible carpet/vinyl cargo mat is particularly useful when that cargo isn't perfectly clean or dry. Infotainment & Technology Jeep's Uconnect system is one of the Compass's stronger everyday attributes, providing an approachable interface for entertainment and connectivity functions. Smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto allows compatible phones to bring familiar apps, navigation, music, and communication functions into the vehicle. This Compass's Popular Equipment Group also adds the 7.0-inch color Driver Information Display between the gauges, giving the driver a richer and more configurable presentation of vehicle information. Remote start, the auto-dimming rearview mirror, steering-wheel controls, and 115-volt auxiliary outlet round out a technology package focused on genuinely useful functions rather than novelty. Safety Features The Compass includes the core active-safety technologies expected of a modern compact SUV, including Electronic Stability Control, traction control, four-wheel anti-lock disc brakes, Electronic Roll Mitigation, a ParkView rear backup camera, and tire-pressure monitoring. Multiple airbags provide occupant protection, while the rearview camera improves visibility during low-speed reversing and parking maneuvers. Jeep's 4x4 and Selec-Terrain systems add another layer of confidence by helping the driver manage traction when road and weather conditions become challenging. The 2020 Compass received a 4-Star Overall Vehicle Score from NHTSA, including a 4-star frontal-crash rating and 5-star side-crash rating. ... and there's SO MUCH more! The Bottom Line With ONLY 49,134 MILES, useful 4X4 capability, REGULAR OIL CHANGES, 16 reported service records, and nearly $2,000 worth of Cold Weather and Popular Equipment packages, this Compass is configured especially well for real-world everyday ownership. Heated seats and steering wheel when it's freezing, remote start before you walk outside, 4x4 when the roads turn ugly, and compact dimensions every other day of the year--that's a combination that's easy to appreciate. description: REFINED, ELECTRIFIED PERFORMANCE, NONSMOKER, SCANDINAVIAN LUXURY WITH A CONSCIENCE! The 2020 Volvo XC60 T8 R-Design pairs Volvo's understated Scandinavian design language with genuinely serious performance, proving that a plug-in hybrid doesn't have to trade away driving enjoyment to deliver real efficiency gains around town. Finished in Black Stone metallic, this XC60 wears its R-Design cues with quiet confidence rather than shouting for attention, a look that has aged remarkably well. Showing about 77,530 miles, this XC60 has clearly been enjoyed as intended, and its combination of a turbocharged and supercharged four-cylinder engine with a rear-mounted electric motor gives it a genuinely different character than any conventional gas-only luxury SUV in its class. That electric motor doesn't just help at the pump, it also powers Volvo's eAWD system, sending power to the rear wheels independently of the gas engine up front for genuinely useful all-weather traction, all while allowing this XC60 to run on electric power alone for genuine daily errands. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The XC60 has become one of the most respected names in the compact luxury SUV segment by leading with genuinely thoughtful design rather than chasing spec-sheet numbers. Reviewers consistently praise its serene, uncluttered cabin, real Scandinavian design sensibility, and a driving experience that prioritizes comfort and composure over aggressive sportiness, appealing to buyers who want luxury that doesn't feel showy. Volvo's decades-long reputation for safety engineering remains a core reason buyers choose this model over its German and Japanese rivals, and the T8 powertrain specifically has broadened that appeal to buyers who want genuine electrified efficiency without stepping down to a smaller vehicle or giving up real power when they need it. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Critics have consistently praised the XC60 for its calm, confident ride, upscale cabin materials, and class-leading safety engineering, reinforcing Volvo's reputation as one of the industry's most safety-focused luxury brands. IIHS TOP SAFETY PICK -- awarded to the 2020 Volvo XC60 for strong crashworthiness performance across all six IIHS evaluations. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 77,530-mile mark, and while Volvo's standard New Vehicle Limited Warranty has expired, this XC60's plug-in hybrid high-voltage battery remains covered under a separate, transferable warranty. Hybrid High-Voltage Battery Warranty -- Covers the high-voltage battery system against defects in materials or workmanship, guaranteeing at least 70 percent of the battery's original energy storage capacity for the life of the warranty. Expiration: 07/31/2028 or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first. STANDARD FEATURES As Volvo's sportier R-Design trim, this XC60 pairs its plug-in hybrid powertrain with a noticeably firmer, more athletic character than the Momentum or Inscription trims, including R-Design's sport-bolstered front seats, a flat-bottomed steering wheel, and gloss-black exterior accents that give the cabin and exterior a more purposeful edge without sacrificing Volvo's trademark comfort. INSTALLED OPTIONS This particular XC60 was ordered with a genuinely well-rounded set of factory options, adding meaningful technology, comfort, and visual presence beyond a standard R-Design. Advanced Package Pilot Assist with Adaptive Cruise Control Helps keep the XC60 centered in its lane and matched to traffic speed on the highway, meaningfully reducing driver fatigue on longer trips. 360-Degree Surround-View Camera Stitches together a bird's-eye view of the vehicle for genuinely easier parking and tight maneuvering. Graphical Head-Up Display Projects speed and navigation information directly into the driver's line of sight. Full LED Headlights with Active Bending Lights Automatically pivot into corners for improved nighttime visibility, and provide noticeably better illumination than the standard headlights. Headlight High-Pressure Cleaning System Keeps the LED headlights clear and performing at their best in poor weather. Standalone Features Heated Rear Seats and Heated Steering Wheel Extend Volvo's excellent seat heating to rear passengers and add welcome warmth on cold mornings before the cabin heats up. Metallic Paint (Black Stone) Adds noticeable depth and richness over a standard solid color. 21'' R-Design Wheels with All-Season Tires Fill the wheel wells with a bolder, more substantial stance while keeping genuine all-weather usability. CHARGING, RANGE & ELECTRIFIED POWERTRAIN This XC60's plug-in hybrid system pairs an 11.6-kWh battery with an 87-horsepower electric motor, delivering an EPA-estimated 19 miles of pure electric range, plenty for many owners' daily commute or errands entirely on electric power. On a Level 2 (240-volt) home or public charger, this XC60 recharges from empty to full in approximately 3 hours. On a standard Level 1 (120-volt) household outlet, a full charge takes roughly 8 to 9 hours, making an overnight charge on ordinary household power a realistic option even without dedicated charging equipment. This XC60 does not support DC fast charging. MECHANICAL FEATURES Volvo's T8 Twin Engine powertrain pairs a turbocharged and supercharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder with a rear-mounted electric motor, delivering a combined 400 horsepower and 472 lb-ft of torque, figures that feel genuinely urgent for a vehicle this size. The gasoline engine alone contributes 313 horsepower, while the electric motor adds an additional 87 horsepower and instant torque off the line, working together through an 8-speed automatic transmission for smooth, confident acceleration. Volvo's eAWD system sends power to the rear axle independently of the front-driven gas engine, giving this XC60 genuinely useful traction in rain or snow without the mechanical complexity of a traditional driveshaft-based all-wheel-drive system. EXTERIOR FEATURES Black Stone metallic gives this XC60 a deep, sophisticated presence, while R-Design's gloss-black exterior trim, unique front and rear bumpers, and dual chrome exhaust tips add a subtly sportier edge to Volvo's already clean, understated design language. The 21'' R-Design wheels fill out the wheel arches nicely, reinforcing the XC60's confident stance, while Volvo's signature Thor's Hammer LED headlights remain one of the most distinctive lighting signatures on the road. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, R-Design's sport seats offer excellent lateral support along with Volvo's trademark comfort, while the heated rear seats and heated steering wheel extend that comfort to passengers and cold-morning commutes alike. The cabin's clean, minimalist dashboard and genuinely upscale materials continue to be one of the XC60's biggest strengths, feeling more like a design showroom than a typical luxury SUV interior. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY Volvo's portrait-oriented touchscreen anchors the cabin's technology, running navigation, media, and vehicle settings through an intuitive, tablet-like interface, complete with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity. The Graphical Head-Up Display adds a further layer of convenience, keeping key information visible without pulling the driver's eyes from the road. SAFETY FEATURES Volvo's Advanced Package brings genuinely useful driver-assistance technology to this XC60, including Pilot Assist with Adaptive Cruise Control and a 360-Degree Surround-View Camera, both of which meaningfully reduce driver workload in traffic and tight parking situations. These systems work alongside Volvo's standard City Safety collision-avoidance technology, reinforcing the brand's long-standing reputation for class-leading safety engineering. ... and there's SO MUCH more! THE BOTTOM LINE Between its genuinely potent 400-horsepower plug-in hybrid powertrain, well-rounded factory options, and active hybrid battery warranty coverage, this XC60 offers a compelling combination of performance, efficiency, and Scandinavian design that's hard to find anywhere else in the segment. Quiet around town, quick when you need it, and never short on personality.
